sc: It is one of three ??? mixtures obtainable during the quest, none of which are useful in completing the challenge.
The achievement banner was the first physical item available from Solomon's General Store.
It can be bought from Wizard Elriss in the Runecrafting Guild for 30 Runecrafting guild tokens (requiring 50 Runecrafting), or ten of them from Wizard Rinsit for 2,000 Runespan points.
The amulet of the forsaken is a potential reward from Barrows.
The amulet was previously a reward from Bounty Hunter, costing 2,000 Bounty Hunter points to purchase from the Bounty Hunter & Deathmatch Reward Shop.
The Armadyl statuette is an ancient artefact available as a drop from revenants in the Forinthry Dungeon.

It was originally a drop from players in PvP worlds and Bounty Hunter worlds to replace certain items that were removed from the drop lists in those worlds (such as the abyssal whip, dragon full helm, and the dragonfire shield).
The augmented chaotic staff is a level 80 magic two-handed weapon created by using an augmentor on a chaotic staff.
The shadow-dyed augmented Khopesh of Tumeken is a level 92 Melee weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Khopesh of Tumeken (shadow), or by using shadow dye on an augmented Khopesh of Tumeken.

tx: Note that the tooltip numbers are not updated by unlocking the Innate Mastery enchantment, although the stats are.
sc: An augmented Ode to Deceit is a level 95 Magic off-hand weapon created by using an augmentor on the Ode to Deceit.
It can be traded with other players.
Currently they can only be obtained as an item used in Jagex Moderator Events by accepting the gift.

Barbarian Helmet.x: Barbarian Helmet is a head slot cosmetic override that is part of the Barbarian outfit.

Battle Robes (Umbra) Gloves.x: Battle Robes (Umbra) Gloves is a hands slot cosmetic override that is part of the Battle Robes (Umbra) set.

sc: Beach Pufferfish Launcher is a two-handed ranged weapon cosmetic override unlocked by redeeming a pufferfish launcher override token.
The shadow-dyed Blightbound crossbow is made by dyeing a blightbound crossbow with a shadow dye.
It can be made into 10 Second wind (brah worldbearer) scrolls by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 0.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 64 elder rune bars and an elder rune 2h sword + 4, requiring 6,400 progress to complete, granting a total of 64,000 Smithing experience.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 bronze bars, requiring 200 progress to complete, granting a total of 30 Smithing experience.
When dropped by a monster, it will be treated like medium plated bronze salvage by the spring cleaner.
It is a pocket slot equipable item obtained from the Saradominist recruitment officer when joining the Saradomin forces in the Battle of Lumbridge.

p: At the first fork in the Goblin Mine from the Lumbridge Castle cellar
sc: The brooch is an item that is obtained during The Lost Tribe quest.
Having obtained the brooch, players must bring it to Duke Horacio.

The Cerberus claws and Cerberus off-hand claws are dual-wield melee weapon overrides that can be unlocked by redeeming a Cerberus claws token, available on Treasure Hunter during the Cerberus Rush promotion.

Climbing rope.x: Climbing ropes are items used in the Castle Wars minigame. They can be picked up from the tables on the floor 2 of the Team's castle, and can be used on the enemy castle battlements, allowing players to climb onto the castle's outer walls.

Closure's robe bottoms.x: Closure's robe bottoms is a legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Closure's robes set.

sc: The Clover Staff is an override unlocked by redeeming a clover staff token.
Clue scroll (easy) is an emote clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.

Clue scroll (hard) - My name is like a t.x: Clue scroll (hard) is a cryptic clue obtained from hard sealed clue scrolls. It contains a clue to solve Treasure Trails.

Colonist's trousers (yellow).x: The yellow colonist's trousers are part of the colonist's outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: The corrupted Ascension signet V is an item dropped by Legio Quintus that can be used to unlock the miniature-boss pet Legio Quintulus.
Cream tea was a food item sold by Bang Ersenmash at his Exotic Foods shop in Varrock Square in celebration of the Diamond Jubilee.

w: Possibility 13 - Lantadymes and crystal tree blossom

tx: If a player enters the reward table, they have the opportunity of receiving one of the items list below. The rarity is after the player manages to get into the reward table; e.g. even though an item may be common, it is still rare when considering there is only a 10% chance to even enter the reward table. It is also possible to win items that are no longer available on Treasure Hunter, such as the Lucky Divine Spirit Shield.
sc: Dazzling three-leaf clover necklace is an item available from Treasure Hunter during the 2015 Christmas event.
Obtained new, the necklace comes with 10 charges, you can use multiple necklaces on each other to have only 1 necklace with all the charges.
Deathbell gloves are tier 7 necromancy tank gloves available in Daemonheim as part of the deathbell armour set.
They are made from ensouled soulbell cloth and ensouled thread with level 62 Crafting.

Deathless Regent Legplates.x: Deathless Regent Legplates is a legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Deathless Regent set.

sc: After reading the book, the diary can be found in the bookcases of a Player-owned house.
The dwarven harvester is an item obtained from small or large dwarven toolboxes.
These toolboxes can be obtained during the Dwarven Tools Treasure Hunter promotion, from Vic's Store, or from the Marketplace.
It can be found amongst the scenery in the Easter Bunny's burrow.
The elder divination head is an item that can be created by combining the divination energy head, divination chronicle head and divination memory head.
These items could be obtained from Treasure Hunter from 00:00 UTC 12 November to 23:59 UTC 16 November 2015.
It can be obtained from Turgall from the Dorgesh-Kaan power station found south of the city.
A ferocious ring is a special ring dropped by the monsters in Kuradal's Dungeon.

Monsters in the dungeon can only be attacked if they are the current Slayer assignment (assigned by Kuradal, Morvran, or Laniakea), leaving an indirect requirement of level 110 combat and level 75 Slayer to obtain it.
The fragile mining urn (full) is an item made by filling a fragile mining urn while mining rocks.
Fremennik hunter's friend is a companion pet that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
It could originally be unlocked by purchasing the Paths to Adventure bundle.

s: Accessed via frozen or warped token
sc: During the 2025 Christmas event, it can also be obtained from Santa's Christmas Presents.

Gemstone Wings (Sapphire).x: Gemstone Wings (Sapphire) is a wings slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Gemstone Wings. It matches the sapphire golem outfit, though unlike the outfit the wings are purely cosmetic and offer no benefits.

Golem of Strength Gauntlets.x: Golem of Strength Gauntlets is a hands slot cosmetic override that is part of the Golem of Strength set.

tx: In addition to producing two blocks of granite (2kg), this also produces two blocks of granite (500g) to match the weight of the source materials.

sc: The green skull cave painting is a relic component that is found by bringing a restored Garagorshuun anchor to the south tunnel entrance in the Warforge Dig Site and sacrificing it by entering the tunnels (players will be prompted before entering if they wish to continue).
Grimy lycopus is the mid-level tier 3 grimy herb found while training Dungeoneering in Daemonheim's dungeons.
It can be obtained as either a monster drop or from planting a lycopus seed, which requires level 84 Farming.

Insignia recharge.x: The insignia recharge is an item that is rarely dropped by the Penance Queen, but is a guaranteed drop from the Penance King.

sc: It, along with the regular Agility master skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached virtual level 120 Agility.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Agility master skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has virtual level 120 Agility.
It, along with the regular defence skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached level 99 Defence.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Defence skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has level 99 Defence.
It, along with the regular fletching skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached level 99 Fletching.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Fletching skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has level 99 Fletching.
It is obtained from the Terry Balando after the player has brought him the Ancient talisman.
Jungle Gorilla is a legendary pet available from Solomon's General Store for 1,100 RuneCoins (990 for members).
Like all Barrows items, this weapon and its ammunition cannot be made using the Fletching skill.
Karil's crossbow appears to have originated from the Eastern Lands as its ammunition is sold by an Eastern Lander named Ak-Haranu.
It is obtained from a Karamthulhu swimming near the ship at the Dragontooth Shipwreck beneath Dragontooth Island.

King Black Dragon (Attuned) Head.x: The King Black Dragon (Attuned) Head is a head slot cosmetic override that is part of the King Black Dragon (Attuned) set. It is the upgraded version of the King Black Dragon Head, unlocked after killing the King Black Dragon 5 times with the full unattuned King Black Dragon outfit equipped.

sc: A large XP lamp (Prayer) is a possible reward from helping Meg in your player-owned port.
It is also one of the lamps that can be obtained by buying a random large XP lamp from the Waiko Reward Shop run by Boni on Waiko for 2,700 chimes.

sc: The loot piñata is a promotional item that is available from Treasure Hunter.
Each loot piñata can be looted once to receive a reward.
It could be obtained by storing summoning scrolls in a Lunar helm (e).
It could be purchased for 1,100 renown after siding with Marimbo, or if the Brassica or Godless Cloaks were bought, without the need to switch sides.
A medium XP lamp (Constitution) is a fairly common prize from Treasure Hunter.
A red Mining tome is an experience reward from the minigame, Temple Trekking.
Mithril dart tips are made with one mithril bar at level 30 Smithing, granting 120 Smithing experience, requiring 400 progress to complete, and yielding 50 dart tips.

Nocturnal Shaman Robe Top.x: The Nocturnal Shaman Robe Top is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Nocturnal Shaman Bundle.

sc: To obtain this item, players must partake in smithing a ceremonial sword after randomly being given plans when they finish smithing an item in the Artisans' Workshop.
Although only members can smith this sword and it is untradeable, the wield option and the stats are available in free-to-play.
It was made by combining a crimson charm with 211 spirit shards and Yak-hide.

Spirit gems, which are dropped by all monsters that drop a single charm and could be received from the Squeal of Fortune, functioned similarly to Runecrafting pouches and stored uncharged summoning pouches before an update.

Perfect juju agility flask.x: A perfect juju agility flask is a potion flask containing up to six doses of perfect juju agility potion. It is created by using a potion flask on perfect juju agility potion with at least six doses of it in your inventory.

sc: A popsicle tray is found in the Seal Camp during Some Like it Cold.
Portent of item protection is a portent created with level 92 Divination using 60 luminous energy and 4 prayer potion (4), or 12 memory shards.
It is obtained as part of the Eggsperimentation activity.
It can be obtained by squeezing either Beanasaurus, Berrisaurus, Branasaurus, or Rootlesaurus Rexes after feeding the Tummisaurus Rex once at any food trough, one time.

It can also be bought from other players and created at level 95 Divination using 10 incandescent energy and three robust mementos, awarding 32.
The rabbit sandwich is an edible item which can be made with the Cooking skill, using bread with a cooked rabbit to make a dry rabbit sandwich and then finishing it off by adding a tomato.
The sandwich cannot be made with roast rabbit (cooked on a spit).
The sacred clay body is a piece of Ranged body armour, bought in Stealing Creation minigame, which has stats identical to the Blue dragonhide body.

Samba loincloth (yellow).x: The yellow samba loincloth is part of the samba outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Samba top (blue, male).x: The blue samba top is part of the samba outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: A Saradomin team hood can be bought from Lanthus at the Castle Wars minigame for 10 silver Castle wars tickets.
It can be found by searching the crate north of Odds inside the Hollow Hill cave.
A small fallen star (Firemaking) is a common prize from Treasure Hunter that can be redeemed for bonus experience in the Firemaking skill.
2× the experience given by a small XP lamp.
A soul urn is an item given to the player by Kili after reaching level 40 Necromancy.
It needs be filled with either 50 souls obtained by killing undead monsters, or five souls from performing lesser communion rituals.
It is crafted from a starbloom robe top + 1 and starbloom cloth using the tailoring process, granting a total of 26,400 Crafting experience.

• Cleaning herbs

• Creating primal extract

It is recommended to clean cheap herbs, ideally those which provide a profit when cleaning, while having the statue collection bag in inventory. The Herblore rock can be one of the fastest rocks to obtain by using this method.
sc: Strange rocks (Herblore) obtained by training Herblore are part of the Dahmaroc statue.
Originally a Treasure Hunter item, they became obtainable as a drop on 6 June 2017 with the release of Menaphos, being found uncommonly from some of the monsters in the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon.
As a Treasure Hunter item, it could be made by combining one of each type of item produced by a crafting catalyst, namely a leather case, gem focus, and a metal setting.

r: Learn the barbarian way of mixing potions.
sc: It is made by using caviar on a super energy (2).
A talisman was an item given by Duke Horacio in the historical version of the Rune Mysteries quest.
It can be purchased for 8,500 Teci (rewarded for completing Liberation of Mazcab) from the Armoursmith in Mazcab.
Thieving XP lamp is a post-quest reward for the Heartstealer quest if the player has at least level 20 Thieving.
It can be claimed from Caelyn Kadaan after the quest, and claiming this lamp completes the achievement redistribution of knowledge.
Thok Your Block Off (unabridged) is received upon completion of an unabridged version of the saga 'Thok Your Block Off'.
Trout is a variant of the trout food item obtained from the tutorial for the Combat Academy, where the player got it from the food table.
The tundral stalker sword is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 23 of The Knight Before Christmas.
It is found by searching a bookcase in the underground area in Kethsi unlocked with the Kethsian key.
Umesco arpos is one of the Jewels of the Elid found while mining in the Worker district or VIP skilling area of Menaphos.
Unfinished business is first obtained sealed and stackable; opening it makes it usable and non-stackable.

Completing a ritual of the preferred type with the opened unfinished business in backpack increases the count by one, same as completing a ritual of a non-preferred type, but gives a better experience reward from the finished business.

V Gauntlets.x: The V Gauntlets are a hands slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the V outfit.

sc: The Valkyrie 2H Crossbow is a two-handed ranged weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased, along with the rest of the Valkyrie Outfit, for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
Can only be obtained through either Adam Antite or Callia.

r: Partial completion of Ritual of the Mahjarrat after finding the tune banite ore scroll
sc: Wallasalkibane bolts (unf) were made by smithing wallasalkibane bars on a Kethsian anvil, requiring level 80 Smithing, producing 75 unfeathered bolts and giving 700 experience per bar.
Wallasalkibane bolts are now made by casting Tune Bane on bane bolts.

Werewolf mask (gold, male).x: The gold werewolf mask is part of the werewolf costume item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: The Wilderness shoulder cape is a reward from Yak Track: Expedition to the Wilderness premium task 50.
It is unlocked through the Looting Range promotion from Treasure Hunter.

Zammo the Rak.x: Zammo the Rak is a boss pet and a miniature version of a greater demon that can be unlocked by inspecting the Jewels of Zamorak, which can be obtained by defeating Zamorak, Lord of Chaos.

sc: The zephyrium kiteshield is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
